Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a critical error in data interpretation and logical deduction. While the search results correctly identified that the snake was depicted with hands in sleeves, the agent failed to verify the biological reality of the other animals in the set. Specifically, it overlooked that the **Monkey** (one of the twelve zodiac animals) naturally possesses hands and would logically be depicted with them in a realistic or semi-realistic jade sculpture, just as the snake's hands were highlighted. By concluding that "only the snake is confirmed to have visible hands" based solely on the text explicitly mentioning the snake, the agent ignored the inherent characteristics of the other animals (like the monkey) which would inherently have visible hands in a sculpture of that nature. This represents a failure to cross-reference the retrieved text with general knowledge or to look for descriptions of the other animals that might have implied hand visibility, leading to an incorrect count of 1 instead of the likely correct count of 2 (Snake and Monkey).
